current_role: Chair, House Judiciary Committee; House Republican leader-elect (minority leader from January 2027)
summary: Jim Jordan has represented Ohio in the House since 2007. He co-founded the House Freedom Caucus, chaired the Judiciary Committee from 2023, and is a close ally of Donald Trump, who awarded him the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2021. After Republicans lost the House in the 2026 midterms, he beat Steve Scalise 106–73 to lead House Republicans in the minority.
